tables.title: Imperative (صيغة الأمر)
rows: Get in and fasten your seatbelt!
Please don't be sick in my taxi!
tables.explanation: صيغة الأمر (Imperative) تستخدم لإعطاء الأوامر، التوجيهات، التحذيرات أو الطلبات. تتكون من الفعل المجرد (base form) في الإثبات، ومن Don't + الفعل المجرد في النفي.
tables.examples: Get in and fasten your seatbelt! / Don't drive too fast! / Please don't be sick in my taxi! / Be quiet! / Don't interrupt me when I am speaking.

tables.title: المزيد من الأمثلة على Imperative
rows: Get in and fasten your seatbelt!
Please don't be sick in my taxi!
Don't exercise after a big meal!
Don't make the same mistake twice!
tables.explanation: صيغة الأمر تستخدم بكثرة في التعليمات اليومية والإرشادات. نستخدم الفعل المجرد للإثبات و Don't + الفعل المجرد للنفي.
tables.examples: Be quiet! This is a library. / When you get to the corner, turn right. / Please wear a helmet when you ride your bike. / Don't wake her up. She's taking a nap.

tables.title: Past Simple (الماضي البسيط)
rows: Edison came home and gave his mother a letter.
She enrolled in a fashion course.
Springmuhl had her first big showcase in 2015.
In 2009, he won the Silver Shell Award.
tables.explanation: يستخدم Past Simple للأحداث التي بدأت وانتهت في وقت محدد في الماضي. الكلمات المفتاحية: in 2015, in 2009, last year, ago.
tables.examples: Edison came home and gave his mother a letter. / Edison's mother hid the letter. / In 2009, he won the Silver Shell Award.

tables.title: Present Simple (المضارع البسيط)
rows: The bus leaves on time every day.
tables.explanation: يستخدم Present Simple للحقائق الثابتة والعادات اليومية. الكلمات المفتاحية: every day, always, usually, often, sometimes, never.
tables.examples: The bus leaves on time every day.

tables.title: Present Continuous (المضارع المستمر)
tables.explanation: يستخدم Present Continuous للأحداث التي تحدث الآن أو في الوقت الحالي. يتكون من am/is/are + V-ing.
tables.examples: People are studying. She's taking a nap.

tables.title: Conjunctions (أدوات الربط)
rows: He couldn't go to school because he was a genius.
Dress warmly so you don't get cold outside.
Save your documents as soon as you finish writing them.
tables.explanation: أدوات الربط تربط الجمل وتظهر العلاقة بينها. 'because' للسبب، 'so' للنتيجة، و 'as soon as' للوقت.
tables.examples: He couldn't go to school because he was a genius. / Dress warmly so you don't get cold outside. / Save your documents as soon as you finish writing them.

tables.title: Prepositions (حروف الجر)
rows: At the age of 30, Edison invented the phonograph.
He sent out messages by using a train whistle.
She persisted with her studies in spite of financial problems.
tables.explanation: حروف الجر تستخدم لربط الكلمات وإظهار العلاقة بينها.
tables.examples: At the age of 30, Edison invented the phonograph. / He sent out messages by using a train whistle. / She persisted with her studies in spite of financial problems.

tables.title: Object Pronouns (ضمائر المفعول به)
rows: My mother made me one of the greatest inventors.
I specifically told you not to go near the water.
Edison's mother believed in her son.
The students brought them to the village.
tables.explanation: ضمائر المفعول به (Object Pronouns) تأتي بعد الفعل أو حرف الجر.
tables.examples: My mother made me one of the greatest inventors. / I specifically told you not to go near the water.

tables.title: Possessive Adjectives (صفات الملكية)
rows: My mother was a great woman.
We went to the forest with our teachers.
tables.explanation: صفات الملكية تأتي قبل الاسم للدلالة على الملكية.
tables.examples: We went to the forest with our teachers. / My mother was a great woman.

tables.title: Articles a / an (أدوات التنكير)
rows: قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت ساكن
a genius, a teacher, a scientist, a designer
قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت علة
an actor, an inventor, an experiment, an award
tables.explanation: نستخدم 'a' قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت ساكن، و 'an' قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت علة (a, e, i, o, u).
tables.examples: Pablo Pineda is an actor. / Thomas Edison was a genius. / She is a designer.

tables.title: Relative Pronouns - who (ضمائر الموصول)
rows: She decided to follow the footsteps of her grandmother who was a designer.
tables.explanation: ضمائر الموصول تستخدم لربط جملتين وذكر معلومات إضافية عن الاسم. 'who' تستخدم للعاقل كفاعل.
tables.examples: She decided to follow the footsteps of her grandmother who was a designer.

tables.title: Modal Verbs - can (الأفعال المساعدة)
rows: They can make the right decision if they are well-trained.
tables.explanation: 'can' هو فعل مساعد يستخدم للتعبير عن الإمكانية أو القدرة على فعل شيء. يأتي بعده الفعل في المصدر.
tables.examples: They can make the right decision if they are well-trained. / I can prove it.

tables.title: Passive Voice (المبني للمجهول)
rows: Her designs were shown at London Fashion Week.
tables.explanation: المبني للمجهول يستخدم عندما يكون الفاعل غير معروف أو غير مهم. يتكون من (was/were) + التصريف الثالث.
tables.examples: In 2016, her designs were shown at London Fashion Week.

tables.title: Question Formation (تكوين السؤال)
rows: What, Who, Where, When, Why, How, ...
I, you, he, she, it, we, they, ...
tables.explanation: لتحويل أي جملة إلى سؤال، نتبع الخطوات: ١- كلمة السؤال ٢- الفعل المساعد ٣- الفاعل ٤- الفعل الرئيسي ٥- باقي الجملة ثم علامة الاستفهام.
tables.examples:
How old was Edison when he invented the phonograph?
Edison was 30 years old when he invented the phonograph.

What did Edison's mother feel as soon as she read the letter?
Edison's mother felt sad as soon as she read the letter.

How many trees did you bring?
We brought one hundred trees.

Who did you go to the forest with?
We went to the forest with our teacher.

When did Springmuhl have her first big showcase?
Springmuhl had her first big showcase in 2015.

What is Pablo Pineda's job?
Pablo Pineda is an actor.
